2. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.
3.
The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.
4. In the present case, from the medical evidence on record, it is proved that the claimant had suffered the following injuries.

i. Contusion over right fronto parietal region, ii. Contusion over left parietal region & iii. C.T. Scan dated 04.01.2014 shows right fronto parietal acute subdued hematoma with fracture lineal undisplaced & right parietal temporal bone with fracture of left parietal bone.

 1. Pain & suffering, mental & 75,000/-
physical shock, inconvenience & loss of amenities in life on account of permanent disability 2.

Medical & other incidental 25,000/-

Total: 1,00,000/-
6. Considering the nature of injuries sustained, compensation awarded by tribunal is lesser side.
Therefore, the same is required to be enhanced by modifying the judgment and award.

7. Considering the injuries sustained, a compensation of Rs.75,000/- awarded under the head injury, pain and suffering is found to be correct, hence, it is kept in tact, Rs.50,000/- towards loss of amenities are NC: 2023:KHC-D:13220 awarded.
The compensation awarded towards medical expenses and hospital charges of Rs.15,000/- is as per the actual bills and receipts produced.

Thus, the claimant is entitled for total compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads.

Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Towards injuries, pain and 75,000/-

 hospital charges  3. Towards loss of amenities.

nourishment, conveyance, etc.,.

Therefore, the claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.1,45,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of filing of the petition till realization, as against Rs.1,00,000/-
awarded by the Tribunal.
The respondents are directed to deposit the compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.

10. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The judgment and award dated 30.09.2015 passed by the tribunal, in MVC.No.2054/2014 stands modified.
iii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.1,45,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% NC: 2023:KHC-D:13220 p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.
iv) The claimant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 66 days in filing the appeal.
v) The respondents shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
